references.text: Jesus' words about abiding in His word and being true disciples are repeated here with a similar requirement to abide in Him and His word in order to have prayers answered.
Here the same concept of abiding in God's word is linked to a mutual relationship where the Father and the Son come to the one who keeps His word.
In this prayer, Jesus refers to the disciples as those who have received His word and kept it, confirming their status as His disciples.
Jesus confirms that the disciples have received His word and are not of the world, just like those in John 8:31 who have believed and kept His word.
Here it is emphasized that it is Jesus' words that judge the one who does not believe, reflecting the warning in 8:31 that failing to abide in His word leads to not being a true disciple.
Peter's answer to Jesus confirms that the disciples have believed and known that Jesus has God's word, and that they are His disciples, which is the core of John 8:31.
